js: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('flt-semantics-placeholder'); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'none'; })()

(() => { let n=0; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('*')) { if (el.tagName.startsWith('FLT-') || el.id==='flutter-main' || el.id==='splash') continue; const id=(el.id||'')+' '+(typeof el.className==='string'?el.className:''); if (/noupe|chat-container|chat-widget|jficc/i.test(id)) { el.remove(); n++; continue; } const cs=getComputedStyle(el); if (cs.position==='fixed' && +cs.zIndex>50) { el.remove(); n++; } } return 'removed '+n; })()
